key_highlights: ASX slumped as bond yields spiked and unemployment hit a 5-year high, pressuring banks and miners
RBA signals continued hawkish stance despite unemployment surge, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD weakness ('trapdoor opens') amid global risk-off and Wall Street spillover
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; Victorian unemployment disproportionately high
Gold exploration sector active: Zenith, Auric, Aureka, and Manhattan report strong WA/Canadian results
Rio2 and Sarytogan advance copper exploration in Peru and Kazakhstan
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need, signalling fiscal tightening ahead
Data centre energy demand threatens power supply security, a structural risk for energy sector

sectors.trend: Gold exploration names (Zenith, Auric, Aureka, Manhattan) report strong drill results; copper exploration (Rio2, Sarytogan) advancing. However, large-cap miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) weighed down by Wall Street risk-off and softening commodity sentiment.
sectors.implications: Junior gold/copper explorers offer relative outperformance; large-cap miners face near-term headwinds from global risk aversion and AUD weakness. Monitor iron ore and copper pricing.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from spiking bond yields, rising unemployment (5-year high), and RBA's hawkish bias. NIM compression risk as rate cycle peaks. Intergenerational Report signals future tax reform pressure.
sectors.implications: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC face margin pressure from unemployment-driven credit losses and rate volatility. Defensive positioning warranted short-term.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating structural energy demand but threatening supply security ('energy bust'). Power price volatility risk for generators and utilities.
sectors.implications: Energy producers (SME, WES, AGL) may benefit from price spikes but face regulatory and infrastructure risk. Monitor AEMO capacity warnings.

sectors.trend: Consumer stress intensifying: over half of renters struggling, Qantas pricing backlash, Jetstar industrial action, McDonald's navigating Ozempic-driven demand shift. House price declines hit consumer confidence.
sectors.implications: WES, WOW, and discretionary names face headwinds. Staples (WOW, WES) relatively resilient but margin pressure from input costs.

sectors.trend: Largest house price falls in 40 years underway; Dusty Martin selling $20m portfolio; CBD tower listed at $40m. Rising bond yields compress property valuations.
sectors.implications: Property and infrastructure REITs (GPW, ICV, VMC) face cap-rate expansion risk. Residential REITs under pressure from falling prices and rising vacancies.

sectors.trend: AI chip and networking stocks (Nvidia, AMD, Lumentum) showing global strength; Australian tech limited. CSL and healthcare stable but flu season and Ozempic trends shift consumer health spending.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Domestic tech exposure limited; global AI trade provides indirect sentiment support.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot vs. rising unemployment creates policy dilemma
AUD weakness amplifies import costs and pressures resource exporters
Bond yield spike threatens equity valuations across ASX
Gold and copper exploration activity signals commodity cycle positioning
Intergenerational Report 2026 foreshadows tax reform and fiscal tightening
House price correction at 40-year pace reshapes consumer and property sectors
Energy infrastructure strain from data centre demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike despite 5-year high unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce financials and property REIT exposure; favour cash and short-duration bonds
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP, RIO) as natural AUD hedge
Underweight residential REITs and construction; monitor NAB/CBA credit loss provisions
Shift toward dividend-paying defensives; reduce growth/tech exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply shortfall from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO reports; consider energy infrastructure plays (SME, WES)
Prepare for potential capital gains or dividend tax changes; review portfolio tax efficiency

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration juniors on strong WA drill results
opportunities.rationale: Zenith, Auric, Aureka, and Manhattan report high-grade hits; gold remains a safe-haven bid amid AUD weakness and global uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Position in large-cap miners as AUD hedge
opportunities.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' benefits export revenue; copper exploration (Rio2, Sarytogan) supports medium-term commodity thesis
Data centre boom creates structural power demand; generators and grid operators benefit from price support

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce bank and property REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising unemployment, bond yield spike, and 40-year house price decline create credit and cap-rate headwinds

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hawkish bias supports yields; bond yield spike may stabilise, offering capital preservation
Renter stress, Qantas pricing backlash, and Jetstar industrial action signal weakening consumer spending

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from bond yield volatility, RBA hawkish signalling, and AUD weakness. Unemployment at 5-year high caps rate hike upside but creates credit risk. Expect choppy, risk-off conditions with miners and gold juniors as relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: Intergenerational Report 2026 and tax reform signal a structural fiscal tightening cycle. House price correction may stabilise within 12 months. Gold/copper exploration pipeline supports materials sector. Energy infrastructure investment cycle offers multi-year opportunity. RBA likely to pivot dovish by H2 2027 as unemployment peaks.
key_catalysts: AUD/USD trajectory and commodity price response
House price data (CoreLogic, SQM) monthly releases
WA gold exploration results (Zenith, Auric, Aureka)
AEMO energy demand forecasts post data centre buildout
watch_list: RBA cash rate and statement (next meeting)
ASX 10-year bond yield vs. equity risk premium
Iron ore, copper, and gold spot prices
CoreLogic house price index (national and Sydney/Melbourne)
US Fed policy spillover and Wall Street volatility
